about.title: About Anne Creations
about.subtitle: Delivering high-quality computer embroidery designs — simple, modern & affordable.
about.description:
At Anne Creations, we specialize exclusively in computer-generated embroidery designs. Our designs are crafted digitally with precise stitch accuracy, ensuring clean output on all embroidery machines.

We aim to make premium embroidery designs affordable for boutiques, home-based businesses, startups, creators and embroidery professionals.
about.mission_text: To empower creators with easy-to-download, machine-ready embroidery designs while offering fair pricing and top-tier quality.
about.vision_text: To be India’s most trusted platform for premium, affordable and modern computer embroidery designs.
about.footer_quote: "Designing Dreams, One Stitch at a Time."

footer.description: Anne Creations HB is a leading company in South India for embroidery design support for single-needle and multi-needle machines.
